sources.title: Clinical evaluation of software (MDR Art. 61 / MDCG 2020-1)
sources.why: Defines the clinical evidence software must show: scientific validity, analytical performance, and clinical performance for the target population.

sources.title: IVDR — in-vitro diagnostic software (Regulation (EU) 2017/746)
sources.why: Requires a performance evaluation (validity plus analytical and clinical performance) validating diagnostic software before market placement.

sources.title: SaMD Class IIb (MDR)
sources.why: Higher-risk software needs in-depth clinical evaluation backed by stronger clinical data, directly raising the evidence-and-validation bar.
